top_signals.title: US Economy Can Withstand Two Rate Hikes, Says UBS’s Reiman
top_signals.summary: Kurt Reiman, head of fixed income at UBS Global Wealth Management, says multiple factors and “definitely not just the deficit” are pushing bond yields higher and explains why he expects two interest-rate hikes from the Federal Reserve this year. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Japan lowers travel alerts for some areas in the Middle East
top_signals.summary: The government said it has lowered its travel alerts for some areas in Israel, Iraq, Lebanon and the Palestinian territories.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
